definitions.explanation: Solid waste matter discharged from the body; also the act of having a bowel movement.

examples.japanese: {大便|だいべん}の{検査|けんさ}をする。
{赤|あか}ちゃんの{大便|だいべん}の{色|いろ}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please pay attention to the color of your baby's stool.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}で{大便|だいべん}の{提出|ていしゅつ}を{求|もと}められた。
examples.english: I was asked to submit a stool sample for my health checkup.

notes:
{大|だい} (large) + {便|べん} (convenience; excretion). The formal, clinical term for feces and bowel movements, used in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大便|だいべん}{検査|けんさ}: stool test
- {大便|だいべん}をする: have a bowel movement
- {大便|だいべん}に{血|ち}が{混|ま}じる: blood in the stool
- {大便|だいべん}の{色|いろ}: stool color

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小便|しょうべん}: urine, urination — the counterpart for liquid waste
- うんち: poo — the everyday, childlike word for feces
- {便|べん}: stool — a shorter medical term often used in compounds
- {排便|はいべん}: defecation — the formal medical term for the act of having a bowel movement

USAGE:
A clinical and formal word. In everyday speech, people use うんち (childlike/casual) or {便|べん} (neutral). {大便|だいべん} is standard in medical forms, health checkup instructions, and scientific contexts.
